findings.title: Worker startup closes a descriptor number a linked library has reused
findings.evidence: Probe exit 1. before_main closes inherited numbers without comparing device and inode. starts_clean can then pass.
findings.reproduction: A shared-library constructor closes an inherited descriptor above 2 and opens /dev/null on the same number. The process is started with SECRET_PROTECTION_CORE_WORKER=0,0,<number>.
findings.expected: A descriptor a library opened before the crate initializer ran stays the library's, as docs/TECHNICAL.md and CHANGELOG.md say.
findings.observed: The initializer closed the reused number. The probe printed FAIL: worker startup closed the linked library's reused descriptor.
findings.impact: The library loses its descriptor and the start can still be reported clean. The probe does not show the parent's original file remaining open.
findings.recommendedFix: Close a number only when it still names the parent's file. If it was reused, leave it and refuse the start as unclean. Narrow the docs until that check exists.
findings.requiredVerification: Reuse probe exits 0, and a descriptor that still names the parent's file is still closed. cargo test --test worker on Linux and macOS.

findings.title: ClosedSecret::is_closed ignores fork generation
findings.evidence: src/protect/closed.rs returns access == Nothing and does not call Pages::here.
findings.reproduction: Fork after creating a ClosedSecret and read is_closed in the continuing child.
findings.expected: False when the child does not hold the pages, consistent with is_locked and is_out_of_children.
findings.observed: True when access is Nothing, including in that child.
findings.impact: Status lie only. A later read or write still aborts before forming a reference.
findings.recommendedFix: Return pages.here() && access == Nothing, and assert that in the fork test.
findings.requiredVerification: cargo test --test secret_memory on Linux and macOS.

findings.title: docs/COVERAGE.md names commit c0c472af for this tree
findings.evidence: Fingerprint recomputed as db750b5041779ce841332935b6fbbb5067be931c62b5dbeda41ba67fb31a5808 while the prose names c0c472af.
findings.reproduction: Compare docs/COVERAGE.md with git rev-parse HEAD.
findings.observed: It says the measured source follows c0c472af2327cc55a561881201db9830613bd3fc.
findings.impact: The percentage can be tied to the wrong commit name. Coverage was not remeasured in this pass.
findings.requiredVerification: Fingerprint unchanged if docs/ stays outside the hash.

findings.title: Build-time macro crates are not named in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
findings.evidence: Notices say the macros of those two. Cargo.lock has enumflags2_derive 0.7.12 and thiserror-impl 2.0.21.
findings.reproduction: Compare locked package names with THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
findings.expected: Each locked crate name and version appears.
findings.observed: Those two macro crates are not named.

findings.title: Crate metadata is still a draft
findings.evidence: Cargo.toml publish = false. README draft warning. CHANGELOG.md heading Unreleased.
findings.expected: A versioned release has a version section. Registry publish is a separate step.
findings.observed: Metadata still describes an unreleased draft.
findings.impact: crates.io publish is refused. In-tree use is not blocked by this item alone.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep publish false until the startup sentence matches the code, then replace Unreleased.
findings.requiredVerification: cargo package --list --locked --offline and a read of the three files.

observations.title: tests/worker.rs has 790 lines of code
observations.evidence: 790 non-blank, non-comment lines, under the 800-line ceiling.
observations.reproduction: Count lines of code in tests/worker.rs.
observations.impact: No defect. A new worker test should be split out rather than appended.
observations.recommendedFix: Put a descriptor-identity test in its own file if one is added.
observations.requiredVerification: Line count after that test is added.

limitations: Coverage, Miri, AddressSanitizer, libFuzzer, WebAssembly, Clippy on six targets, cargo audit, and GitHub Actions were not re-executed in this pass.
Windows, macOS, Android and iOS were not run.
Replacing descriptors 0, 1 or 2 in a constructor was not executed and is not a confirmed leak.
The reuse probe does not show the parent's original file remaining open.
